data.title: Semiconductor stocks lead Nasdaq's weekly decliners amid wider hit on AI trade
data.description:
The Nasdaq Composite Index closed flat in the green on Friday, a day after falling more than 1%. It ended +0.64% at 27,366.17 points.

The tech-heavy index came under pressure on Thursday amid a wider impact on AI trade due to revenue concerns surrounding OpenAI . Reports indicated that OpenAI's annualized revenue reached $50B at the end of September, below the $68B figure reported the previous month.

For the week, Nasdaq was flat but in positive territory at +0.64%. The gains were led by Constellation Energy , which rose over 12% earlier in the week after announcing a nuclear deal with Google to bring 890 megawatts of new nuclear capacity to the PJM grid.

On the other hand, semiconductor stocks dragged down the index for the week. Arm Holdings led the losses, followed by Intel .

data.title: QTREX receives Nasdaq non-compliance notice
data.description:
QTREX Quantum announced Friday that it received a written Nasdaq notification, indicating that, the closing bid price of the company’s ordinary shares had been below the minimum of $1 per share for the 30 consecutive business days.

In accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rules, the company has been provided a period of 180 calendar days from the date of the notification, or until April 3, 2027, to regain compliance with the minimum bid price requirement.

The company highlighted that the notification has no immediate effect on the listing or trading of its ordinary shares, which continue to be listed and traded on Nasdaq under the symbol “QTEX”.

data.title: CytoMed Therapeutics receives Nasdaq notice over minimum bid price deficiency
data.description:

  • The company has until April 5, 2027, to restore compliance by keeping its closing bid price at or above $1 for at least 10 consecutive business days.

data.title: India's TCS senior staff will miss out on variable pay for September quarter, memo shows
data.description:
By Sai Ishwarbharath B

Senior staff at India's Tata Consultancy Services will miss out on quarterly bonuses after the company failed to meet performance targets, according to an internal memo seen by Reuters, the first time in at least two years all variable pay was withheld for some workers.

"For associates C3A grade and above, there will be no QVA (quarterly variable allowance) this quarter. This decision was taken after careful consideration as our performance for the quarter fell short of internal targets," said Sudeep Kunnumal, chief human resource officer in the memo.

Associates in C3A and above grades are employees with typically 7-10 years of experience up to senior-level management. The junior-level employees will get 100% of the eligible pay, the memo added.

Mails sent to TCS did not elicit a response. Employees, speaking on the condition of anonymity, said typically the company awards 50-100% of variable pay and it is the first time in at least two years that the company has explicitly said no bonuses shall be awarded.

This comes as the country's largest IT firm reported its weakest September-quarter sequential revenue growth ‌in three years, signaling continued pressure on traditional IT services demand even as AI-related revenue jumped nearly 20%. The uptick in AI revenue, however, was cheered by investors on Friday as the stock rose as much as 6.2%.

India's $315 billion IT sector is also facing uncertainty stemming from the Trump administration as it suspended major IT outsourcers including TCS, Infosys , HCLTech from a key green-card program on Thursday, widening a crackdown it says targets fraud and protects American ‌jobs.

data.title: Microsoft's Nadella Unveils Microsoft-Decision 1, A New AI Model For Fast Decisions
data.description:
Key points:
  • Evaluated across 36 blind benchmarks, Microsoft-Decision-1 recorded 4.5 times faster execution than its closest competitor and ran roughly 35 times faster than traditional large language models like GPT-6 Sol. 
  • The system focuses strictly on generating calibrated probability outputs for multiple-choice, rating, and pass-fail decisions rather than general text generation. 
  • Available immediately via Microsoft Foundry (and coming soon to OpenRouter), the model costs $0.042 per million input tokens, with output tokens provided at no charge. 

Microsoft Corp.(MSFT) announced Friday the launch of a specialized artificial intelligence system designed to execute rapid automated decisions, marking a strategic pivot toward lower-cost, highly targeted AI tools for enterprise workflows.

The new software, titled Microsoft-Decision-1, is engineered to handle tasks such as sorting incoming queries, routing system requests, verifying data, and managing autonomous agents.

Unlike conventional large language models built around conversational text, decision models are designed to evaluate defined options and output direct, structured metrics that software programs can consume without human intervention.

Achint Srivastava, Vice President of Software Engineering at Microsoft's Office of the CTO, said in a statement that decision-scoring systems represent an emerging category intended to address latency bottlenecks in software automation.

MSFT stock gained about 2.3% on Friday and ended the week 3.4% higher.

Overcoming Speed And Accuracy

A key challenge in multi-step AI operations is accumulated delay. When multiple automated decisions execute sequentially, slight lags at each step can slow down entire applications.

To tackle this, Microsoft engineers post-trained a 9-billion-parameter base model (Qwen3.5-9B). In benchmark testing spanning nearly 150,000 blind evaluations, the system recorded the highest accuracy among evaluated models while operating at roughly 35 times the speed of flagship text models such as ChatGPT’s GPT-6 Sol.

The model also demonstrated stability against prompt manipulation. Internal evaluations showed the system changed its decision output in only 1.3% of cases when requests were paraphrased or when option orders were re-sorted.

Real-World Applications And Costing

Microsoft reported that several internal teams have already deployed the model to streamline operations. For instance, Xbox Research used the tool to categorize more than 10,000 player reviews into structured categories, achieving a 14x speed increase over previous setups.

The Microsoft Copilot team used the system for quality assurance checks on interactive agent responses, operating up to 100 times faster than prior configurations.

Microsoft-Decision-1 is accessible to developers through Microsoft Foundry, with plans to expand availability to OpenRouter. Input token processing costs $0.042 per million tokens, while output tokens are free. Microsoft said future iterations of the software will incorporate alternative model foundations, including OpenAI technology.

MSFT Stock: Retail View 

Retail sentiment on Stocktwits was ‘neutral’ with ‘normal’ message volumes.

MSFT stock has gained about 10.3% year-to-date.

data.title: SpaceX, AT&T, Crown Castle, Delta, Humana, and More Stocks That Explain Today's Market — Barrons.com
data.description:
By George Glover, Mariapaula Gonzalez, and Connor Smith

Stocks rose Friday and many technology stocks rebounded as investors moved past concerns over OpenAI's sluggish revenue and looked ahead to next week's earnings slate.

SpaceX rose 1.3% after the rocket and artificial-intelligence company bought spectrum from Grain Management, which it said would "pave the way for Starlink Mobile to become a major mobile carrier in the U.S."

The news triggered a selloff across telecommunication stocks. AT&T and Verizon each tumbled nearly 10%, while T-Mobile slumped 13%. The wireless carriers were the S&P 500's worst three performers as investors fretted over SpaceX's move into telecom.

Cell tower stocks, however, got a boost. American Tower gained 9.3%, Crown Castle climbed 16%, and SBA Communications advanced 7.3%.

Apple dropped 1.1%. Nikkei Asia reported Friday that Apple told suppliers to cut production of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max components due to soft consumer demand.

Delta Air Lines was flat after the airline missed analysts' fiscal third-quarter earnings targets as the Iran war sparked a surge in jet fuel prices that drove up costs.

Humana jumped 12% after the federal government released new ratings data on Medicare Advantage plans, showing Humana achieved a four-star rating on a key contract closely watched by Wall Street.

Cryptocurrency stocks rose as Bitcoin briefly topped $83,000, marking a sharp rebound from earlier this week, as global tensions intensified and energy costs rose. Strategy gained 1.9%, Robinhood Markets advanced 1.9%, and Coinbase added 4.3%.

Some AI stocks rebounded a day after a report about ChatGPT developer OpenAI's weaker-than-expected revenue sparked a selloff. Others traded in the red: Advanced Micro Devices, Intel, and Sandisk all fell.

Fastly jumped 16%. Oppenheimer upgraded shares to Outperform from Perform with a $35 price target, pointing to the company's early monetization of agentic AI traffic.

Lumentum Holdings rose 5.2%. CEO Michael Hurlston said Friday in an interview with Bloomberg TV that the company's optical components have almost sold out through 2029. He added that Lumentum will struggle to meet as much as 70% of demand for certain products through next year.

data.title: McGraw Hill Refinances With $400M 8% Notes, $930M Term Loan, Extends ABL to 2031
data.description:
McGraw Hill completed a comprehensive refinancing, issuing $400 million of 8.000% senior secured notes due 2033, entering an amended and restated cash flow credit agreement with a $930 million term loan and a $150 million revolver, and extending its ABL revolver maturity to October 9, 2031. Proceeds were used to redeem the company's 5.750% secured notes due 2028 and refinance its prior term loan and cash flow revolver. The transactions extend maturities, enhance liquidity, and streamline the capital structure.

  • Counterparty: Noteholders; Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, as trustee and notes collateral agent
  • Signed / Effective: Oct 09 2026 / Oct 09 2026
  • Duration / Termination: Due 2033
  • Reason: Refinance debt and extend maturities

Agreement 2: McGraw Hill Amends and Restates Credit Agreement With $930M Term Loan, $150M Revolver

  • Agreement type: Amended and Restated Cash Flow Credit Agreement (term loan and revolving credit facility)

Arcus Biosciences, Inc. (), a clinical-stage, global biopharmaceutical company focused on developing differentiated molecules and combination therapies for the treatment of cancer and inflammatory diseases, today announced that the Compensation Committee of the Company’s Board of Directors granted 2 new employees options to purchase a total of 9,150 shares of the Company’s common stock at an exercise price per share of $23.83, which was the closing price on October 8, 2026, and restricted stock units to acquire a total of 4,600 shares of the Company’s common stock. About Arcus Biosciences

Arcus Biosciences is a clinical-stage, global biopharmaceutical company focused on developing differentiated molecules for the treatment of cancer and inflammatory diseases. In partnership with industry collaborators, patients and physicians around the world, Arcus is expediting the development of its late-stage portfolio of first- and/or best-in-class medicines against well-characterized biological targets and pathways and studying novel, biology-driven combinations that have the potential to help people with cancer live longer. Founded in 2015, the company has advanced multiple investigational medicines into registrational clinical trials including casdatifan, a HIF-2α inhibitor for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, and quemliclustat, a small-molecule CD73 inhibitor for pancreatic cancer. For more information about Arcus Biosciences’ clinical and preclinical programs, please visit www.arcusbio.com.

data.title: US stocks end week higher as focus shifts to earnings, inflation
data.description:
Key points:
  • Main US equity indexes end higher; Dow out front, up ~0.8%
  • Real estate leads S&P 500 sector gainers; Communication Services weakest group
  • Dollar, bitcoin gain; gold up ~1.5%; US crude ~flat
  • US 10-year Treasury yield edges up to ~5.24%

US STOCKS END WEEK HIGHER AS FOCUS SHIFTS TO EARNINGS, INFLATION

Wall Street finished higher on Friday as investors looked ahead to a potentially pivotal week, with third-quarter earnings season kicking off and fresh inflation data on tap that could help shape expectations for the Federal Reserve's next move.

By week's end, some of the market's recent headwinds had eased. NYMEX crude futures were only modestly higher on the week, while the benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield was on pace to snap a five-week winning streak.

Most S&P 500 CBOE:SPX sectors advanced on Friday. Healthcare , consumer discretionary and real estate led the way, each climbing more than 1.5%. Energy and communication services were the only sectors to finish modestly in the red.

Beneath the surface, gold and silver miners (.XAU), software and services (.SPLRCIS) and biotech stocks were among the strongest performers. Housing-related shares , meanwhile, lagged.

There were also signs of improving breadth. The S&P 500 Equal Weight Index (.SPXEW) ended a seven-week losing streak, while S&P 500 Value outperformed S&P 500 Growth (.IGX) for the first time in four weeks.

For the week, the S&P 500 gained 1.2%, while the Dow rose 0.9%. The Nasdaq Composite added 0.65%, extending its winning streak to four weeks. The small-cap Russell 2000 managed to hold key support levels, though it still finished lower for a fifth consecutive week.

data.title: Cord Blood Banking Leader Cryo-Cell Reports Fiscal Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
data.description:
Cryo-Cell International, Inc. (NYSE American, Symbol: CCEL) (the “Company”, “Cryo-Cell”), the world’s first private cord blood bank to separate and store stem cells in 1992, announced results for the fiscal third quarter ended August 31, 2026.

Financial Results

Revenue
Consolidated revenues for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 were $7.82 million compared to $7.83 million for the third quarter of fiscal 2025.

Net Income
The Company reported net income of $1.27 million, or $0.16 per basic and diluted share, for the three months ended August 31, 2026, compared to net income of $749,000, or $0.09 per basic and diluted share, for the three months ended August 31, 2025.

About Cryo-Cell International, Inc.
Founded in 1989, Cryo-Cell International, Inc. is the world’s first private cord blood bank. The Company, together with its global affiliates, stores more than 250,000 cord blood and cord tissue specimens for the exclusive benefit of newborn babies and their families. In addition to its private bank, Cryo-Cell ‎International, Inc. has a public banking program in partnership with Duke University. Cryo-Cell’s ‎public bank has provided cord blood for more than 900 transplants. Cryo-Cell’s facility is FDA-registered, cGMP-/cGTP-compliant, and licensed in all states requiring licensure. In addition to AABB accreditation as a cord blood facility, Cryo-Cell was the first U.S. private (family-use) cord blood bank to receive FACT accreditation for adhering to the most stringent cord blood quality standards set by any internationally recognized, independent accrediting organization. Cryo-Cell holds exclusive rights to PrepaCyte-CB, the industry’s most advanced cord blood processing technology. Cryo-Cell’s mission is to provide clients with the premier cord blood and cord tissue cryopreservation service and to aid in the advancement of regenerative medicine.
